8. If concern for malignancy (persistent, atypical mass or nonhealing lesion), consider wider excisional biopsy and gynecologic oncology input.

Obtaining these will permit confirmation (or exclusion) of vulvar Crohn disease and rule out infections, hidradenitis suppurativa, lymphatic obstruction, neoplasm, or other dermatoses.
